change: Replace the global linear residual expert with a frozen local empirical expert and neighbor-based support; retain the v12 utility acceptance criteria and data splits.

expert_definition.coordinates: Same ten v12 physical coordinates, standardized on the expert-fit source prefix only.
expert_definition.value: Source-turbine-balanced weighted median of the 32 nearest stored fit residuals, separately for each event and horizon.
expert_definition.support: At least eight neighbor turbines and kth squared distance within the fit-only 95th-percentile leave-one-turbine-out distance radius.
expert_definition.identity: All memory cases, original fit residuals, neighbor rule, support geometry, physical features, implementation and fixed base checkpoint are bound to one expert hash.
expert_definition.update_rule: Memory changes create a new expert identity and invalidate all old utility evidence.

mechanism_diagnostics: Report all physical candidates on the source fit and calibration blocks: signed/absolute correction, cap-hit fraction and MAE/RMSE gain. These diagnostics do not change the declared parameters.
scope_note: Single declared development pilot prompted by v12 training-side extrapolation failures. The previously inspected original-train interval is not independent confirmation. No changes to the frozen v1 semantic-Wiki results.
